description: This file is a C source code file containing test utility functions and test result management logic for a testing framework, including path manipulation, test assertions, and output formatting.

methods.name: make_relative
methods.description: Converts an absolute or relative file path to a path relative to the test file, handling Windows and Unix path separators.

methods.name: msg_with_prefix
methods.description: Outputs a formatted message with an optional prefix, flushing stdout and stderr.

methods.name: test_msg
methods.description: Prints a test message prefixed with '# '.

methods.name: test_plan
methods.description: Outputs the test plan with total count and resets lazy plan flag.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Finalizes testing, outputs test results, and handles lazy plan if needed.

methods.name: test_skip
methods.description: Marks a test as skipped with an optional message.

methods.name: test_skip_all
methods.description: Skips all remaining tests, outputs appropriate message, and sets skip flags.

methods.name: test__run_describe
methods.description: Sets the current test description and relative location.

methods.name: test__run_begin
methods.description: Starts a new test, resetting context and handling previous test end if needed.

methods.name: test__run_end
methods.description: Ends a test, outputs result based on context, and updates failure status.

methods.name: test_assert
methods.description: Checks a condition within a test, logs failure if condition is false.

methods.name: test__todo_begin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a TODO test.

methods.name: test__todo_end
methods.description: Ends a TODO test, logs success or failure accordingly.

methods.name: check_bool_loc
methods.description: Checks a boolean condition with location info.

methods.name: check_pointer_eq_loc
methods.description: Checks pointer equality with location info.

methods.name: check_int_loc
methods.description: Checks integer equality with location info.

methods.name: check_uint_loc
methods.description: Checks unsigned integer equality with location info.

methods.name: check_char_loc
methods.description: Checks character equality with location info.

methods.name: check_str_loc
methods.description: Checks string equality with location info.
